class.name: DisplayServerEmbedded
class.brief_description: Display server for rendering into surfaces supplied by a host application.
class.description: Used by LibGodot when an application embeds Godot rendering in its native UI. The host supplies rendering surfaces, display information, and input events.

method.name: detach_native_surface
method.description: Detaches the specified window on the Godot main thread. Returns [code]true[/code] after previous renderer access completes and engine references to the surface are released. Repeating a successful detach is allowed. Returns [code]false[/code] for an unknown window or when detaching cannot complete; the host must then retain native resources until full engine cleanup.

method.name: get_singleton
method.description: Returns the active embedded display server, or [code]null[/code] when another display server is active.

method.name: resize_window
method.description: Updates the size of the embedded window identified by [param id], in pixels.

method.name: set_content_scale
method.description: Updates the content scale reported by the embedded display server.

method.name: set_native_surface
method.description: Assigns the main rendering surface before embedded display server initialization.

method.name: set_screen_get_dpi_callback
method.description: Sets the host callback used to query screen density in dots per inch.

method.name: set_screen_get_scale_callback
method.description: Sets the host callback used to query the screen scale.

method.name: set_screen_get_size_callback
method.description: Sets the host callback used to query the screen size.

method.name: touches_canceled
method.description: Cancels the touch identified by [param idx] in the specified [param window].
